summary: The GenericDocument system is responsible for managing, validating, adding, deleting, retrieving, and displaying document records and their associated metadata in the context of agency, site, and destination profiles. It supports sorting, ordering, and formatting of document data, and handles document assignment to different entities via stored procedures. The system provides comprehensive business logic for working with documents, including workflow for adding documents, retrieval by parent ID or other criteria, displaying formatted URLs, and managing deletion. User details, agency info, disciplines, and document metadata are included and validated, with configurable options for subdisciplines and alternate languages.
purpose: To provide a robust workflow for the management of generic documents related to agency, site, and destination profiles in a database-driven system. This includes CRUD operations, validation, sorting, workflow automation, formatted output for document links and user info, and business rule enforcement for document type and requirements.

workflows.name: Add Document
steps: Validate document fields (FileURL not blank, TypeCodeID != 0, DocumentName not blank)
Set stored procedure name and add parameters
Execute query to add record and retrieve new document ID

workflows.name: Get Documents By ParentID
steps: Set stored procedure and parameters based on parent entity and discipline info
Execute query and fetch document list
Apply sorting or ordering via Sort or Section fields

workflows.name: Delete Document
steps: Fetch document file path based on ID
Delete file and folder if exists (handle exceptions silently)
Delete database record with stored procedure

workflows.name: Assign Document to Destinations/Sites
steps: Add session, document, and destination/site parameters

workflows.name: Document Link Formatting
steps: Check if document is of type (has FilePath)
If applied and file exists, create formatted link with file type, size, and name
If not applied or file missing, create disabled/greyed link or mark as Not Found

business_rules: Document cannot be added without FileURL, TypeCodeID, or DocumentName
Documents can be assigned to destinations/sites via stored procedures
Documents support sorting/order by Section or parent entity
If alternate language is used, TypeCodeAlt is used
If Code is 'OTHER', always display as 'Other'
Email link is formatted if Email is non-empty
calculations: Document link title includes file type (translated), file size (in KBytes), and document name
AgencyUserFormatted = AgencyShortName + initials from FirstName, MiddleName, LastName
TooltipDetails includes formatted name, agency, and phone if available
conditions: If IsDocumentType (FilePath non-empty), link is created
If file exists, show link; else mark as Not Found
If CanEditRow is false, show inherited agency/site profile text
If Section is non-empty, use it for sorting
If UseAltLanguageFields is true, TypeCodeAlt is used
system_behavior: Supports CRUD on documents tied to parent entities
Handles errors silently for file/folder deletion
Retrieves and formats document/user info for display
Supports alternate language and subdiscipline listing
Orders documents based on Sort/Section info and handles gaps
dependencies: Database stored procedures for CRUD and assignment
Resources for localization and error messages
UI components for formatting names and URLs
exceptions: Silent catches for file/folder deletion in Delete
content_gaps: User interface details are not included; requires UI layer reference.
Some referenced resources (e.g., Resources upload error and localization) are not described in detail.
Details on discipline/subdiscipline and alternate database handling are brief.
Behavior for exceptional errors (other than file/folder deletion) is not fully documented.
Exact implementation of UI.Localization.TranslateFileType and UI.DateFormatter.FormatDateShort is not included.
